description: Paid per call from your key's SingIt balance and limits in USDC. The server enforces per-request and daily caps; a call over a cap is refused before anything is charged. Use list_models for model ids and prices, get_limits for what remains, and get_receipts for the charge. Pass max_tokens high enough for reasoning models: thinking uses the same budget.

max_tokens.description: Longest answer, in tokens (1 to 8192, default 1024). Reasoning models think inside this budget, so leave room.

messages.description: A whole conversation instead of prompt: text messages, oldest first.

model.description: A SingIt model id from list_models, without a free/ prefix. Omit it for SingIt's default model.

prompt.description: The question, as one user message. Send exactly one of prompt or messages.

system.description: An optional system message; only together with prompt.
